## Prevention & Controls  
### System Controls (Fraud Detection Engine)  
**Real-Time Blocking:**
- High-risk transactions auto-blocked
- Risky transactions require OTP verification
- Medium-risk transactions held for manual review  
**Authentication Strengthening:**
- Multi-factor authentication (MFA) for online banking
- Biometric authentication for mobile
- SMS/email confirmation for transfers  
**Transaction Limits:**
- Daily withdrawal limit (per card): £500 ATM
- Daily transfer limit: Configurable by customer (default £50k)
- New beneficiary limits: £1k for first transfer

raw_entities.name: Prevention & Controls Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the prevention and control mechanisms for fraud, specifically focusing on system controls, authentication, and transaction limits.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Engine
raw_entities.description: An automated system used to detect and manage fraud risk through real-time blocking and risk-based transaction handling.

raw_entities.name: Real-Time Blocking of High-Risk Transactions
raw_entities.description: Mandates that transactions identified as high-risk must be automatically blocked by the system.

raw_entities.name: OTP Verification for Risky Transactions
raw_entities.description: Requires that transactions categorized as risky must undergo One-Time Password (OTP) verification before proceeding.

raw_entities.name: Manual Review for Medium-Risk Transactions
raw_entities.description: Requires that transactions categorized as medium-risk be held for manual review by staff.
context: Medium-risk transactions held for manual review

raw_entities.name: Multi-factor Authentication
raw_entities.description: A security control requiring multiple forms of verification for accessing online banking services.

raw_entities.name: Biometric Authentication
raw_entities.description: A security control utilizing biological characteristics for authentication on mobile platforms.

raw_entities.name: Transfer Confirmation
raw_entities.description: A control requiring confirmation via SMS or email for financial transfers.

raw_entities.name: Daily ATM Withdrawal Limit
raw_entities.description: Sets a mandatory maximum daily withdrawal limit of £500 per card at ATMs.

raw_entities.name: Daily Transfer Limit Configuration
raw_entities.description: Establishes a default daily transfer limit of £50k, which is configurable by the customer.
context: Daily transfer limit: Configurable by customer (default £50k)

raw_entities.name: New Beneficiary First Transfer Limit
raw_entities.description: Restricts the first transfer to a new beneficiary to a maximum amount of £1k.
context: New beneficiary limits: £1k for first transfer

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: The risk of fraudulent activity, mitigated through system controls, authentication strengthening, and transaction limits.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The bank customer who has the authority to configure their own daily transfer limits.

raw_entities.name: Payment Card
raw_entities.description: A payment card subject to daily ATM withdrawal limits.
